proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.destination_override
proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item activation shape can model charges, dawn recharge, and charge-cast spell access, but it cannot constrain casts to the plane keyed to the pressed cube face. Omitting that would author a false item that can cast Gate or Plane Shift to arbitrary destinations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Pressing one side of the cube, you cast Gate, opening a portal to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access.destination_override
proposed_widenings.justification: Plane Shift from the cube is likewise parameterized by the selected face rather than chosen freely at cast time. The current surface has target restrictions only; it has no spell-parameter override for destination plane.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Pressing one side of the cube twice, you cast Plane Shift, transporting the targets to the plane of existence keyed to that side."

notes: Magic-item activation + charge_pool + dawn recharge fits. The blocker is destination-plane binding to the selected cube face. I did not author a placeholder Dhall/JSON because that would misstate the item's core mechanic.
